function: PPO-based deep reinforcement learning jointly designs transmit beamforming (power and hybrid MRT/ZF coefficient) and RIS phase shifts to maximize energy efficiency (p. 2-3).
system: K=4 transmitter-RIS-user pairs, NT=8 transmit antennas, single-antenna users, reflecting RIS with 8 elements each, blocked direct links, interference channels; carrier band not stated (p. 1-2, p. 4).
method: PPO actor-critic reinforcement learning, fully connected networks with 3 layers of 256 units; hybrid MRT/ZF action space with learnable coefficient and activation functions for constraints (p. 3-4).
data_channel: Simulated channels; no channel model, fading distribution, path loss, public dataset or measurement is specified; average SNR 10 dB (p. 4).
test_conditions: Trained and evaluated with K=4, NT=8, 8 elements, SNR 10 dB (p. 4); Fig. 3 enumerates coefficients for NT=4, K=2 without training; Fig. 6 sweeps the rate requirement (p. 5).
baselines: Non-learned: optimized beamforming vectors, MRT, ZF (Fig. 3). Learned variants: PPO with MRT, ZF or end-to-end beamforming, AC instead of PPO, penalty method (p. 4-5).
metrics: Energy efficiency [bit/Hz/J]: average EE versus episode and versus rate requirement, convergence speed (p. 4-5).
complexity: none; only layer sizes and output-port counts are given, with output ports reduced from 2KNT to 2K (p. 3-4).
q1_support: p. 4: "The average signal-to-noise-ratio (SNR) is set by 10 dB." The paper never defines its channel model: no 3GPP, DeepMIMO, measured data or named fading model.
q2_support: p. 4: "K = 4 transmitter-RIS-user pairs" is the only trained configuration; Fig. 3 (NT = 4, K = 2) enumerates coefficients without a trained model and Fig. 6 sweeps the rate requirement, so no new scenario is tested.
q3_support: p. 4: "the end-to-end beamforming scheme are respectively adopted to design the action space". Fig. 3 uses non-learned MRT, ZF and optimization, but the learned comparisons (Fig. 4) are variants of the proposed PPO method; no earlier published learned design is compared.
q4_support: p. 3: "the number of output ports due to the beamforming vectors of the neural networks is decreased". Only network sizes and port counts are given (pp. 3-4); no parameter count, FLOPs, complexity order or runtime is reported.
q5_support: p. 4: "We simulate a system model". Custom simulation; no code or data link, and no public channel dataset or measured data.
notes: Included as area 3 (beamforming and RIS phase shifts, p. 2-3). Title and DOI on p. 1 match. Borderline q3: the learned comparisons in Fig. 4 and Fig. 6 are the MRT-only, ZF-only, end-to-end and AC variants of the proposed scheme (ablations or other training); the paper does not equate them with earlier designs [13]-[15], so q3 is 0, but a reviewer reading the MRT/ZF-based DRL of [13]-[15] as earlier learned methods would set q3 to 1. Borderline q4: Remark 1 gives the output-port reduction (2KNT to 2K), a size of the output layer, not a computational cost.
